study: Hard time scratch: does flattening a trade that has not gone green within 60 or 90 seconds (instead of the live 180 s) raise the mean per trade on the same entries, without costing opens?
registered_at: 2026-10-14 ~05:10 ET, before any replay with these values ran.
origin: docs/PLAN_2026-10-14.md section 3 / queue item 4. October: 90 never-green trades = -$108 of the -$121 net (mean -31 bp); 1-3 minute holds were the only profitable bucket (+$6, 47% winners).
prior: Exits own the win rate, not the mean (42 shapes; memory exits-cannot-move-the-mean). Holding longer loses more (fills drift -9 / -28 / -43 bp at 5 / 15 / 30 min). 10/13 replay: no-progress 600 s vs 180 s differed by +0.3 bp (t 0.36). Prior: a small gain at best.
mechanism: No new code. The live exit ai_positions.no_progress_due (mirrored in tools/replay_session.py _live_exit): flatten when the position is confirmed, the trail has not locked above entry, age since fill >= ai_no_progress_sec, and MFE < ai_no_progress_mfe_r (0.001 R live, about 0.5 bp: effectively never green).
config: Every arm pins the WHOLE bot_config.json of commit 73217e4 (482 keys: 09:45 start, premarket seating, 45 s scans, 5 slots x 20%, breakeven 0.15%, decay 4 s + overtake, profit capture off, square + pre-square, $10 floor) via replay_session --set-json, then the arm's --set. The code sha is the runner's HEAD, which must contain --set-json; every result records sha and set_json_sha, and the scorer refuses mixed results. (Round 1 pinned only 30 keys, so older days kept 5-17 of their own; fixed.)
data: The ten recorded sessions with snapshots: 2026-09-30, 10-01, 10-02, 10-05, 10-06, 10-07, 10-08, 10-09, 10-12, 10-13. Half A = the first five, half B = the last five (calendar, fixed now).
run_discipline: After 16:15 ET; at most 3 replay_session runs on the box at once, counting runs that are not part of this batch; results in a fresh /tmp/ngs_<stamp> directory.

statistic.paired: Trades matched across arms by symbol and entry time within 90 s (each control trade matched at most once). Per day: mean of (arm gross - control gross) over matched trades. Day-equal mean and day-clustered t over the 10 days.
statistic.day_total: Per day: sum over closed trades of (gross - 10 bp), arm minus control (a shorter scratch can free slots and add trades, each paying a round trip). 3 bp is a sensitivity line. Trade-count difference per day is printed.
statistic.opens: Entries per 10 minutes: closed plus open at the end of the replay.

pass: An arm PASSES only if: paired day-equal mean > 0 with t >= 2.0 over the 10 days, AND paired mean > 0 in each half, AND charged (10 bp) day total >= control on >= 6 of 10 days, AND opens per 10 min >= 90% of control. VACUOUS if the arm's no_progress exits do not exceed control's. INCOMPLETE (no verdict) if any of the 10 days x 5 arms is missing, any run failed, or results differ in code or pinned config. Fewer than 30 matched trades in a half = UNDERPOWERED. Two arms graded; a single pass is 1 of 2.
information_only: paired diff split by the control trade's outcome: trades the scratch cut that later went green under control vs trades that stayed red
mean hold and concurrency per arm
matched pairs and trade-count difference per day
rate-limit lines found in each replay log
fidelity: replay np180 no_progress share vs live share on 10/08, 10/09, 10/12 (180 s was live)
caveats: Replay fills at the recorded price with no spread; every exit costs one round trip in every arm, so the spread cancels in the paired diff but not in the day total if the arm opens more trades. Replay fidelity ~0.7 recall (10/13). Recorded replays fill at the dashboard price, which can be stale. The replay starts at 09:30 with an empty book, so premarket seating is not replayed. MFE is sampled every 2 s from the dashboard price in replay, per stream print live; at a one-tick floor that can change which trades count as never green (see the fidelity line).
no_retuning: 60 / 90 / 180 s, the 0.001 R floor, the 10 days and the 90 s match window are fixed.
if_pass: Ship the passing value (the shorter if both pass) after operator approval, then read it live for >= 10 sessions against the replay prediction.
if_fail: Keep 180 s. The scratch idea is closed as an exit lever; never-green losses remain an entry/name problem.
script: scripts/no_green_scratch_replays.sh (one batch for this prereg, no_momentum_seats_prereg.json and keep_falling_seats_prereg.json); scorer tools/studies/no_green_scratch_score.py --dir <batch> --sha <code sha>; tests tests/test_no_green_scratch_score.py.
